sources.title: Amharic Passage Retrieval Models | PDF | Information Retrieval ... - Scribd
sources.snippet: This document presents optimized text embedding models and benchmarks for Amharic passage retrieval, addressing challenges faced by low-resource, morphologically rich languages. The authors introduce Amharic-specific dense retrieval models based on pre-trained BERT and RoBERTa, achieving significant improvements in retrieval effectiveness compared to existing multilingual models. sources.title: GitHub - rasyosef/bert-amharic: BERT transformer models pretrained on ...
sources.snippet: This repo contains 4 BERT transformer models pretrained on 290 million tokens of Amharic text. All four models have a context length of 512 tokens and the same tokenizer with a vocabulary size of 28672 tokens.

sources.title: bert-base-multilingual-cased-finetuned-amharic
sources.snippet: It provides better performance than the multilingual Amharic on named entity recognition datasets. Specifically, this model is a bert-base-multilingual-cased model that was fine-tuned on Amharic corpus using Amharic vocabulary.

sources.title: README.md · Davlan/bert-base-multilingual-cased-finetuned-amharic at main
sources.snippet: Model description bert-base-multilingual-cased-finetuned-amharic is a Amharic BERT model obtained by replacing mBERT vocabulary by amharic vocabulary because the language was not supported, and fine-tuning bert-base-multilingual-cased model on Amharic language texts. It provides better performance than the multilingual Amharic on named entity recognition datasets.
